summary: Reverified s1_category_coverage_ai_vs_sketch, s1_flexibility_ai_vs_sketch, and s1_light_ring_homogenization_ai_vs_sketch against the paper and the extraction rules. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references; the 14-page paper has no appendix. Extracted and checked every cited PDF page (3, 4, 6, 7, and 8), with additional context from pages 5, 11, and 12. Both script flags are false positives. PDF p. 7, Section 4.2.3, prints the flexibility means as "4,2 versus 2 categories explored per student" for AI (B+D) versus sketch (A+C); 4.2 is the same value and precision expressed as a JSON number. PDF p. 8, Figure 5 caption, explicitly describes "two bubble charts" and maps them to the sketch and AI conditions. Section 4.2.3 establishes that each chart represents its condition-wide pool of categorized ideas, so n_units=2 is supported for unit=set. The flexibility and category-coverage participant counts (30 AI, 31 sketch, 61 total) match the printed study and design-task counts on PDF pp. 3-4. Section 4.2.3 on p. 7 repeats the arm counts and describes categorizing each participant’s total ideas, supporting their applicability to these full-condition analyses; no participant exclusions are reported for this categorization. The separate prompt-log exclusions do not apply to these outcomes. For light-ring homogenization, PDF p. 6, Section 4.2.2, prints 18 out of 30 AI students (60%); treatment_mean=60 and n_treatment=30 are correct. The paper supplies no corresponding sketch prevalence, sketch denominator, or combined count for this specific concept, so control_mean, n_control, and n_total correctly remain null. Category-coverage arm totals are not printed in prose or a table and correctly remain null; no category totals were counted from the figure. No uncertainty is reported for these full-condition contrasts, so se_basis=not_reported and the null uncertainty fields are correct. The requested question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person, and comparison codes are consistent with the paper and codebook. All eligible full-sample outcomes and contrasts are represented in the extraction; no additional estimate is missing under rules 4-6.
